research_question: Does the supported lower-volume callback timing and capture-integrity result extend from one repeated utterance to six speakers and fieldsites with balanced infant- and adult-directed natural speech?
panel_rationale: Use only already-spent Music Lab PCM. Fix six distinct fieldsites and speakers, balance three infant-directed and three adult-directed speech clips, keep source duration at most 15 seconds so a fixed 20-second capture includes trailing quiet, and require source peak absolute amplitude at least 0.65 so every clip credibly exercises the salient workload at the unchanged gain.

fixed_runtime.input: XVF3800 callback device :0, 16 kHz, two fused channels
fixed_runtime.room: same semi-quiet room with laptop-fan background

panel_acceptance: All per-stimulus criteria must pass. No pooled average may hide a failed fieldsite, condition, clipping, timing, or stream-integrity gate.
run_policy: Run the fixed six stimuli once each in listed order. A source-start or device-open failure before playback may be retried without changing the protocol. Once playback begins, retain the run and do not replace a failed acoustic, timing, clipping, or integrity result.
interpretation_rule: A full pass extends Stage 6 natural-speech host-software timing and capture integrity to this six-fieldsite balanced panel. A failure identifies its stimulus and leaves the previous one-utterance result intact.
claim_boundary: Purposefully salient, already-spent adult speech recordings; one run per new stimulus; approximate uncalibrated knob position; fixed room, geometry, XVF3800, and M4 Pro host. This cannot establish population sampling, semantic/register accuracy, calibrated SPL, geometry or room transfer, XMOS internal latency, wall-plug energy, or cross-device performance.
